entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to remove the defect(s), as pointed out by the office, if any, within a period of four weeks from today.

3. Petitioner seeks bail who is in custody since 21.05.2023 in connection with Agamkuan P.S. Case No. 1000 of 2022, F.I.R. dated 20.12.2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323,
506, 308/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
4. According to prosecution case, the informant alleged that her marriage took place 12 years ago and from that date she was being subjected to cruelty by the petitioner and his family members.
It is further alleged that this petitioner in drunken state, assaulted her and also tried to kill her.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52980 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 5
. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

He further submits that in fact the informant / complainant is residing in her parental house since 2021 and when she came to know that the petitioner has filed a divorce case against her then she has also filed this present case against the petitioner.
The petitioner is in custody since 21.05.2023.

sentences.text: 6. The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant has outrightly submits that she is ready to settle the matter with the petitioner.
7. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the informant, let the petitioner and the informant physically appear before the Patna High Court, Mediation Center on 28.08.2023.
8. The Learned mediator shall endeavor and explore the possibilities for amicable settlement of disputes between the parties within a period of six months and submit his report.

9. In view of the aforesaid, let the petitioner, above named, be released on provisional bail for a period of 7 months and on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate- Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52980 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 IV, Patna City in connection with Agamkuan P.S. Case No. 1000 of 2022, subject to the following conditions:-
i. Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be properly represented on each and every date fixed by the court and shall remain physically present as directed by the court and on his absence on two consecutive dates without sufficient reason, his bail bond shall be cancelled by the Court below.
ii.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate- Patna High Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: If the petitioner tampers with the evidence or the witnesses, in that case, the prosecution will be at liberty to move for cancellation of bail.

iii. And further condition that the court below shall verify the criminal antecedent of the petitioner and in case at any stage it is found that the petitioner has concealed his criminal antecedent, the court below shall take step for cancellation of bail bond of the petitioner.
However, the acceptance of bail bonds in terms of the above-mentioned order shall not be delayed for purpose of or in the name of verification.
10. Put up this case on 27.03.2024.

(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) Vanisha/-
